Class CLIView

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am23.view.cli.CLIView
All Implemented Interfaces:
VirtualView
public final class CLIView extends Object implements VirtualView
Command line view for the Mesos client. It talks to the server through a VirtualServer, keeps a local copy of the game state, reads commands from the user and prints what is going on. Every server callback updates the cached state and triggers a re-render of the current screen.

  • Method Details

    • main

      public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception
      Entry point of the CLI client. Builds the terminal, asks the user for the host, the connection type and a nickname, then connects to the server and starts the main command loop. The user is asked again for the nickname until the server accepts it.
      Parameters:
      args - ignored
      Throws:
      Exception - if the terminal cannot be created

    • connect

      public void connect(String host, String nickname, String connectionType) throws Exception
      Opens a connection to the server and waits until the handshake is done. On success the lobby list is requested right away so the user can see what is available. If the server rejects the nickname an IllegalStateException is thrown with the reason, so the caller can ask the user to pick another one.
      Parameters:
      host - the server host name or address
      nickname - the nickname requested by the user
      connectionType - either "RMI" or "SOCKET"
      Throws:
      Exception - if the network setup fails or the server refuses the connection

    • run

      public void run()
      Main loop. Draws the current screen, then keeps reading commands from the line reader until the user quits or the input stream is closed. Any exception thrown by a command is caught and shown on the screen so the loop never dies because of a bad input.
